head: de376d7210f586d8839fe48949b0f2400db05433
classification_reasons: Blast radius: about 25 plugin and template files across gate, ci, pr, release, init, evidence, skills, agents and commands, plus four workflow templates and fourteen test files.

Contract change: the gate record gains a `proof` entry at (c), (d) and (e) and a fourth `runs` key; `DEFERRABLE_CHECKS`, `red_targets`, `limits.run_caps` and `evidence_status` change signature or meaning; the runner's commands step is on the port list.
Spec is tight (three concerns closed by the panel, acceptance measurable), but every proof test is new and the step's riskiest path (run_deferred_commands) gains a branch no existing test covers.
attempted: Intent: each Proposed outcome bullet maps to a requirement (R1 drive key and comment, R2 runner step at c/d/e never b, R3 three-target readers unchanged, R4 job arithmetic, R5 item grammar, R6 manifest, R7 proof entry on the approved plan, R8 image caps, R9 gate (b) refusal, R10 /sdlc-init Playwright proposal, R11 four-log lists, R12 PR body, R13 triage, R14 two folders, R15 commands and agents, R16 version). Both open questions are answered or carried forward with a reason. Nothing found that solves a nearby problem instead.

Spec and plan: every plan step cites its requirements; the three concerns read `decided (by panel #n)` and the decisions are applied (R1/R10 shell sentence, R4 fix-template worst case and cancellation sentence, R5 one parse and strict JSON equality, plan steps 1, 11, 12). Plan's 'Files that change' covers every file the spec's Design names.

Proof: phase (b), no code yet; the plan's Proof lists one `test:` line per test file with the behaviours from the spec's Acceptance, including the panel's four comparison cases and a test that no drive runs at (b). No toolchain logs are expected at (b).

Blast radius: the committed diff is only the change folder (spec, plan, status.yaml, evidence and panel files); no guardrail file, no risk-list hit (risk-hits empty). Plan's Risks name the record readers, the four `limits.run_caps` callers, the two `run_phase.run_caps`/`run_timeout_seconds` call sites, the three `evidence_status` callers and the `auto-round.json` target shape.

Policies: security-baseline (drive runs under commands_env with no token or model credential, owner-only command string, regex from the approved plan on a 1 MiB-capped file, path containment under proof/), data-conventions (synthetic data in the comment, additive record changes, manifest names commit and run), coding-standards and definition-of-done applied in R16; no rule silently skipped.
Tests: the plan forbids weakening the text tests and keeps `test_the_runner_s_commands_step_*` and the head_matches tests untouched; change_type is feature, so the fix-type lock does not apply.

Claim checked: `checks.commands_from_config` reads build, test, lint only (checks.py:267-277); `missing_targets` lists those three (373-385); `run_targets`/`judge_targets` shapes as described (388-433).

Claim checked: `gate.DEFERRABLE_CHECKS = ("commands", "evidence")` (gate.py:389); `write_deferred_logs` writes only marked logs unless `all_targets` (465-496), called with `all_targets=phase in HEADER_REQUIRED_AT` (574-576), so at (c) only marked logs today, as the spec says; `not_started` and `COMMANDS_CRASH_NEED` exist; only deferred entries are replaced (607-613).
Claim checked: `CHECKS_BY_PHASE["b"]` holds `check_commands` (checks.py:2172), so the runner step does run at (b) and the plan's guard and test for no drive there are needed and present.

Claim checked: `auto_round.red_targets` returns None as soon as `commands` is ok (auto_round.py:114) and any other failed check parks (147-160); `head_matches` (295), `REQUEST_TEXT`, `red_targets_request`, `JUDGE_PROMPT`, `targets_summary` all exist as named.

Claim checked: `limits.run_caps(gate_settings, build)` (limits.py:84) with callers run_phase.py:356, :398, limits.py:502 (`check_limits`) and sdlc_init.py:267 (`keep_build_caps`): four, as the plan says; defaults 120 general and 180 build minutes.

Claim checked: `run_phase.run_caps`/`run_timeout_seconds` (391-405) and their session call sites run_phase.py:2082 (`--max-turns`) and :3333 (`invoke`); `gate_phase = st.phase if phase == "fix" else phase` (3106) exists; scan/cli.py:192 also calls `run_timeout_seconds` with no gate phase, which keeps today's caps under the plan's default.

Claim checked: arithmetic. `commands_timeout_seconds` = 3 x 900 + 300 = 50 min today, 55 with a 300 s drive. Build/fix 185+50+10=245, 250 with drive; test 125+50+10=185, 190; deploy template comment 125 + 185 + 45 = 355 (sdlc-deploy.yml:62-71) and with the (e) session at 115+5 and step 55: 125+120+55+10+45=355; fix at (e) 45+185+50+10=290 and 45+180+55+10=290. All figures in R4 hold.

Claim checked: `evidence_status(change_dir, phase)` (description.py:239) has three callers: description.py:758 (root in scope), pr/cli.py:236 `check_run_result(root, ...)`, release/notes.py:156 `_evidence_line(change_dir)` called from `build_notes(root, ...)` (240), so passing root is feasible; `LOG_FILES` (79) and the screenshot count including `.gitkeep` (247-249) are as described.

Claim checked: `detect.node_dependencies` (detect.py:593), `Detection` with `setup: Target` and `as_dict` (101-124); `sdlc_init.py` has `--setup` (1092) and `SETUP_CMD` rendering (218); `triage.logs_for` adds only the three target logs on a failed `commands` (triage.py:138-139); ux-conventions check.py globs `evidence/*` directly (60-69); sdlc-test.md:83 carries the 'evidence missing only when' sentence; `artifacts.linked_part`, `write_evidence_log`, `run_phase.commit_run_record`, `base_update.recheck`, `release/cli.py recheck_targets`, collect.py `TARGETS` and `--only` all exist.

Claim checked: decisions 2, 19, 21, 29, 32 (build caps raised for the build run and fix rounds, 32.md:13), 35 and 37 are in docs/decisions/index.md with the titles the spec relies on; no cited decision is contradicted.

Observation, not a reason: R7 and plan step 4 say `check_evidence` requires `drive.log` at (d) and (e) when the drive is set, and the session never writes it (no mark, by the plan's own choice). Today's `check_evidence` (checks.py:461-466) reports a missing file before it considers deferral, so a literal build would fail the in-session (d)/(e) evidence check. The Design's 'the evidence deferred reason names the drive log when set' shows the intended reading (accept a missing drive.log while commands are deferred), and the runner step re-judges evidence because it writes drive.log (gate.py:593), so the final verdict comes out right. The build should state the exemption and add a test for the in-session (d) gate with a drive set.

Observation, not a reason: R7's 'gate (b) ensured the approved plan names no state or screenshot item' when the drive is empty does not hold if the owner later empties `commands.drive` in a reviewed PR; the approved items would then go unchecked under 'no drive target'. Only the owner can cause this, and it is visible in their own config PR.
